Brilliant! White wins the rook (material gain of +5 for White). This is a textbook fork: the queen checks the king and attacks the rook simultaneously, forcing the king to move and allowing White to capture the undefended rook.

**Coaching note:** The king on f6 is exposed and the rook on f8 has no escape. When you spot a check that also attacks an undefended piece, calculate if it wins material. Here, Qh6+ forces the king away and nets the rook—a decisive material advantage. Always look for moves that do two things at once: give check AND threaten a loose piece.
